shortBulletSummary: Crypto Market Downtrend & Extreme Fear: Bitcoin trades around $60K, extending its H1 2026 losses, while the Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains at 13, signaling "Extreme Fear."
ETF Outflows Intensify: Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $1.3 billion in net outflows this past week, and Ethereum ETFs saw their seventh consecutive day of outflows.
Sticky US Inflation Damps Rate Cut Hopes: The US PCE price index accelerated to 4.1%, reducing expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts and making non-yielding assets less attractive.
Strategy Firm Concerns Mount: Shares of major Bitcoin holder Strategy fell almost 50% this month, sparking fears of potential BTC sales and market instability.
Geopolitical Tensions & Oil Prices: US military action in the Strait of Hormuz has heightened geopolitical tensions, impacting oil markets and global supply, adding to broader market risk.
